games.name: BuffNook Tower
games.title: BuffNook Tower · Free Physics Stacking Game
games.description: Stack 12 physics blocks on a seesaw. Survive 5 buffs. Decide when to bank. BuffNook Tower is a free browser game — desktop & mobile, no account required.

games.intro: Twelve blocks land on a tilted seesaw. Some blocks glue, some sink, some float, some slide. Bank your height at any point to keep 100% of it — but if you wait too long, the tower collapses and your score drops to 40% of the height you reached. Free to play in your browser, no account needed.

howto.text: Q / E rotates the falling block 15°. Space drops it. L banks the tower after 3 blocks — hold still for 1.5 seconds and keep 100% of your height.
Click the left/right rotate buttons, tap the drop keycap, or drag directly on the canvas to aim. Everything works with just one hand.
Tap rotate, tap drop, tap bank. On a phone the game fits the screen height automatically, so the canvas and the control buttons below it always stay visible — no scrolling, no pinching.

games.goal: Your daily official run is locked on your first completed drop of the day (UTC reset). Any later run is a practice score that does not overwrite the official result. A successful bank scores 100% of your height; a collapse during the 1.5-second lock confirmation keeps 50%; collapsing before you bank keeps 40%. Banking at 300 cm scores 300 cm; collapsing at 300 cm scores 120 cm. Progress is saved locally in localStorage.

tips.title: Wait a beat before aiming
tips.text: The seesaw sways for half a second after each block lands. Aim when the tower settles, not when it's still wobbling.

tips.title: Treat each buff as a question
tips.text: Glue sinks and stays — good for anchoring the base. Lead presses the beam down — park it on the light side. Float cancels lead exactly. Ice slides everything — land it last or not at all. Expand grows after it lands — give it room or it will push the tower over.

tips.title: Bank at your personal ceiling
tips.text: Most players collapse around the 280–340 cm mark. If your tower hits 280 and nothing obvious is wrong, bank it — a bank keeps 100% of your height, while waiting too long drops you to 40%.

faq.q: When does the daily challenge reset?
faq.a: BuffNook Tower resets every day at 00:00 UTC. New seed, new sequence, everyone in the world sees the same 12 blocks that day.

faq.q: Why is my score lower than the tower height?
faq.a: Height is measured on the seesaw in centimeters — a successful bank scores 100% of your height, a collapse during lock confirmation keeps 50%, and collapsing before you bank keeps 40%. Banking at 300 cm scores 300 cm; collapsing at 300 cm scores 120 cm.

faq.q: What is the difference between official and practice?
faq.a: Your first completed run each day is your official score — locked, archived, never overwritten. Every run after that is a practice run, saved separately for your own benchmarking.

faq.q: Is BuffNook Tower free to play?
faq.a: Yes. BuffNook Tower is 100% free to play in your browser — no account, no downloads, and no paywalls required. Progress saves only to your browser's localStorage under the key buffnook.tower.save. Clearing site data will reset it.

faq.q: Can I play on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. On a phone the game fits the screen height automatically and the rotate, drop and lock buttons stay visible below the canvas — every action is reachable with one hand. Works on iOS Safari and Chrome on Android.
